hypothesis: The full-midpoint/cache joint pass shows nonredundant adaptation and recurrence information; weighting each preceding same-stream cache symbol by its decoder-visible prior branch error will recover at least 10000 actual faithful-trace bytes, beat the frozen uniform cache and a rotated-error association control by at least 1000 bytes each, and improve over uniform cache in every original-coordinate third.
interfaces_exposed: Earlier decoded symbol plus its earlier realized branch error -> weighted cache posterior on the same current NNCP symbol branches
kill_condition: Any identity failure, sub-10000 total gain, sub-1000 margin, nonpositive incremental third, decode mismatch, nondeterminism, or source excess retires branch-residual weighting without weight transform, floor, window, prior, lag, or bucket sweeps.
promotion_condition: Exact independently terminated weighted-cache gain at least 10000 bytes, margin over uniform cache and rotated-error control at least 1000 bytes each, weighted-minus-uniform positive in every original-coordinate third, repeat byte identity, exact symbol decode, and compressed source at most 65536 bytes.
retired_neighborhoods: No cache-window, prior, lag, weight-floor, error-transform, or bucket rescue around a miss.
title: NNCP branch-residual-weighted addressless cache
